t: The city of La Spezia
s: By boat: From the Cinque Terre villages and Portovenere you can reach La Spezia by boat. The boats are running frequently from the end of March until November 1. There is also a good variety of shops for those wanting to buy Italian clothing and shoes.

t: La Spezia - Wikipedia
